text:
Victor Olofsson is back in Vegas after a season split between Colorado and Calgary, and he has scored like a man with a point to prove: 7 goals and 11 points in 9 games. He missed about a month after getting hurt against Seattle in early October, then came back on Nov. 5 and scored in three straight games, including one from the ice against Nashville.

Our form check calls the run earned, to a point. Vegas has created 13.3 expected goals with him on the ice over these games against the 8.9 we'd usually expect (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and at five-on-five the team takes 69% of them with him out there. "The third line is still hot," as The Athletic's Jesse Granger put it.

The finishing is the part that won't last. He has 7 goals on 3.4 expected, shooting 28% after 9% last season. The chances are real; that rate rarely holds. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level in 2025-26, with strong teammates flattering his raw numbers. Nine games is a small sample. Watch whether the chances keep coming once the puck stops going in at this rate.
headline: Olofsson's second Vegas stint is all goals
